Summary of websites posted in the 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com — Reports on the latest job report, noting a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a rustic atmosphere, and guests enjoy panoramic city views through large windows. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make every visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, simple start, but I noticed it only shows your name and email addresses with very little content. I'd suggest adding a short bio, some info about your interests or work, and maybe a photo or a few links to make it more engaging and personal. Also, consider using a contact form or a single clear email rather than listing multiple addresses, which can look a bit cluttered. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a lovely start — hiking is a wonderful hobby to write about! Right now the page is quite minimal, so I'd suggest adding some actual blog posts about your hiking adventures, photos from the trails, and maybe tips or gear recommendations. A bit more structure (like a menu or categories) would also make it easier to explore. Looking forward to reading more!
